arguments.query: code review approvals before merge to main branch

answer:57f2db93-6a8b-494f-94f1-70492c1f0: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:2fcd3f2b-8cd9-4db6-b947-7ead2f8cd: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:2b43f09f-51e3-4b53-8db9-f893896ea: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:8a0cebd3-014e-40aa-a64f-9fb2aaf1b: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:a20b29ec-3114-4d06-be8d-f4bf3219b: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
